meta.name: create-soap-note
meta.description: Generate structured medical SOAP notes with all required sections in a single comprehensive file write.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键生成结构化医疗SOAP病历
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是医护人员需要快速生成标准SOAP格式的病历记录。
copy.tagline_en: Generate structured medical SOAP notes with one click
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a healthcare professional needing to create standard SOAP-format medical records quickly.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能一次性生成完整的 SOAP 医疗笔记文件，包含主观、客观、评估和计划四个标准部分，并写入单个文件。
howto.when: 当你提供患者信息（年龄、性别等）、就诊详情和临床数据，要求创建 SOAP 笔记时触发。

say.text: 用这些患者信息生成一份 SOAP 笔记。
say.note: Claude 会写入包含所有必需部分的完整文件。

say.text: 写一份 SOAP 笔记，患者 45 岁男性，主诉胸痛。
say.note: Claude 会根据提供的数据填充各节内容。

say.text: 生成一个 SOAP 笔记文件，包含体检和诊断结果。
say.note: Claude 会一次性完成所有内容写入。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to generate a complete SOAP medical note file in one go, including Subjective, Objective, Assessment, and Plan sections, written to a single file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide patient demographics, visit details, and clinical data, and request creation of a SOAP note.

say_en.text: Generate a SOAP note using this patient information.
say_en.note: Claude will write a complete file with all required sections.

say_en.text: Write a SOAP note for a 45-year-old male with chest pain.
say_en.note: Claude will populate sections based on provided data.

say_en.text: Create a SOAP note file including exam and lab results.
say_en.note: Claude will write all content in one operation.
